title: RNA Electrophoresis in Acrylamide Gels
author: Jonathan Houseley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bnszmef6

steps.title: Prepare Gel Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL of an 8% acrylamide, 1× TBE, 42% (w/v) urea solution in a 15 mL tube (Falcon/Corning type).

substeps.instruction: Warm the solution to 50 °C until the urea dissolves.
Allow the solution to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Cast the Gel
steps.instruction: Prepare an empty gel cassette and polymerize the gel.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 10% APS to the gel solution and invert to mix.
Add 10 µL of TEMED and mix again.
Pour the gel into the empty gel cassette.
Carefully push in the comb at a slight angle, avoiding bubbles in the wells.

steps.title: Prepare Samples and Ladder
steps.instruction: Mix the RNA samples and the DNA molecular weight marker with loading dye.

substeps.instruction: Mix samples with 5 µL of 2× formamide loading dye.
Mix 1 µL of 50 bp DNA molecular weight marker with 5 µL of 2× loading dye.

steps.title: Denature Samples
steps.instruction: Once the gel has set (20–30 minutes), denature the samples and ladder.

substeps.instruction: Heat samples and ladder at 95 °C for 5 minutes.
Chill on ice for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Running Apparatus
steps.instruction: Set up the electrophoresis equipment with heated buffer.

substeps.instruction: Heat 750 mL of 1× TBE buffer to approximately 50 °C.
Assemble the gel running apparatus according to manufacturer instructions.
Fill the inner chamber with the hot buffer.
Fill the outer chamber with hot buffer until it is 5 mm from the top of the tank.

steps.title: Prepare Gel Wells
steps.instruction: While samples are on ice, prepare the gel for loading.

substeps.instruction: Remove the comb from the gel.
Use a needle and syringe to clean urea out of the wells.

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load the samples and run the gel immediately at 300 V to maintain gel heat and resolution.

substeps.instruction: Migrate the gel until the xylene cyanol dye reaches the bottom of the gel.

steps.title: Stain and Destain Gel
steps.instruction: Visualize the RNA bands using ethidium bromide staining.

substeps.instruction: Dismantle the apparatus according to manufacturer's instructions.
Place the gel in 0.5× TBE containing ethidium bromide (1 μL per 100 mL) and shake gently for 15 minutes.
Replace the staining solution with fresh 0.5× TBE and destain for 15 minutes on a shaker.

steps.title: Image Gel
steps.instruction: Acquire the gel image using a transilluminator or fluorescence imager.
